question: Among molecules containing either iodine or sulfur atoms that participate in single bonds, determine whether carcinogenic or non-carcinogenic molecules are more common.

prediction.sql:

    SELECT DISTINCT m."XCL_010" AS molecule_id, m."XCL_011" AS carcinogenic_flag
    FROM molecule AS m
    INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m."XCL_010" = a."XCL_002"
    INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a."XCL_001" = c."XCL_007"
    INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c."XCL_009" = b."XCL_004"
    WHERE a."XCL_003" IN ('i', 's')
      AND b."XCL_006" = '-'
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN carcinogenic_flag = '+' THEN num_molecules ELSE 0 END) >
             MAX(CASE WHEN carcinogenic_flag <> '+' THEN num_molecules ELSE 0 END)
        THEN 'carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'non-carcinogenic'
    END AS more_common
FROM (
    SELECT carcinogenic_flag, COUNT(*) AS num_molecules
    FROM qualifying_molecules
    GROUP BY carcinogenic_flag
) AS counts
